Next.|A shoretrooper processes Tuck Hybecks|}} '''Galdi''' was a [[planet]] located in an [[Galdi system|eponymous star system]] within the [[Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. Situated in the [[Reithcas sector]], a [[Sector|subsector]] of the [[Sullust sector]], at the coordinates M-18 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was the [[homeworld]] of the [[human]] [[Tuck Hybecks]]. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|108}} a convicted Hybecks had to state their homeworld while being processed by an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Unidentified shoretrooper (Niamos)|shoretrooper]] on the planet{{Databank|niamos|Niamos}} [[Niamos]]. The [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretrooper]], in response to this information, directed Hybecks to a [[Imperial Troop Transport|transport]] destined for the astronomical object[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] [[Belsavis]], in order for them to serve their sentence. ==Behind the scenes== Galdi was mentioned in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
